continuity: The quest timer begins counting down from five minutes as Taekyung fights the Blood Lord alongside Jeok Cheongang and Cheongpung.
Taekyung is near death but evades the Blood Lord’s attacks with unexplained, seemingly instinctive precision.
The Blood Lord absorbs battlefield blood to replenish his strength; a wound in his palm remains unhealed after Taekyung’s earlier attack.
Cheongpung is seriously pressured by the Blood Lord, and Jeok Cheongang is knocked away.
Taekyung’s spear pierces the Blood Lord’s wounded palm at the chapter’s end; the result is unresolved.
plot: With five minutes remaining, Jin Taekyung, Jeok Cheongang, and Cheongpung attack the Blood Lord together, but his counterstrike devastates the battlefield and leaves all three battered. Taekyung narrowly evades the Blood Lord’s attacks as if guided by instinct, while Cheongpung is knocked to one knee and Jeok is sent flying. Taekyung then thrusts his spear through the Blood Lord’s palm—the same hand that had already been wounded and had not healed.
